findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: redeem_invite, list_disputable_reviews, get_case, list_review_triage, get_outcomes, claim_packet, appeal_packet, set_evidence_endpoint, invite_member, get_checkout_link, next_invoice · Private data: request_access, redeem_invite, send_feedback, claim_packet, mark_filed, record_prereq, record_decision, appeal_packet, record_appeal, decline_packet, set_business_profile, set_evidence_endpoint · Public sink: redeem_invite, send_feedback, list_disputable_reviews, get_case, list_review_triage, mark_filed, record_prereq, record_decision, invite_member, get_checkout_link · Destructive: run_audit, redeem_invite, remove_member.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: redeem_invite, list_disputable_reviews, get_case, list_review_triage, get_outcomes, claim_packet, appeal_packet, set_evidence_endpoint, invite_member, get_checkout_link, next_invoice · Private data: request_access, redeem_invite, send_feedback, claim_packet, mark_filed, record_prereq, record_decision, appeal_packet, record_appeal, decline_packet, set_business_profile, set_evidence_endpoint · Public sink: redeem_invite, send_feedback, list_disputable_reviews, get_case, list_review_triage, mark_filed, record_prereq, record_decision, invite_member, get_checkout_link · Destructive: run_audit, redeem_invite, remove_member

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
